Senses.Explanation: Intellectual understanding is knowing reached through interpreting or explanation. The corpus overwhelmingly uses the term as a rebuke or warning. Its flagship form is 'a follower of the intellectual-understanding lineage' (知解宗徒, 35 occurrences), a label applied to Shenhui and Guifeng Zongmi: even Shenhui and Guifeng were rejected as followers of intellectual understanding (神會、圭峰尚斥為知解宗徒). In an origin case, a student names the matter 'Buddha-nature at the original source,' and Huineng says that even if this fellow later founds a place, he will become only a follower of intellectual understanding (此子已後設有把茅蓋頭，只成得箇知解宗徒). Another passage puts a whole list of teaching styles under the same verdict (此等見解盡屬知解宗徒). The common gate-entry warning 'harbor no intellectual understanding' (莫存知解) occurs 80 times. Mi'an Xianjie continues by comparing its non-arising to the king's sword. Other records say people are deceived by intellectual understanding and conjecture (多被知解卜度瞞過), or that the matter is not an affair on the side of intellectual understanding (不是知解邊事). The headword occurs 1,044 times in 215 allowlist texts. This entry reports the corpus's repeated pejorative deployment without turning it into a general theory of mind. Huangbo Xiyun extends the term through a food-and-digestion comparison: 'what is called intellectual understanding not digested is all poison' (所謂知解不消。皆為毒藥). Parallel witnesses preserve the same wording in two other collections.
Senses.Note: A corpus-wide pejorative. The origin rebuke and the naming of Shenhui and Zongmi as followers of intellectual understanding (知解宗徒) are raised material, while 'harbor no intellectual understanding' (莫存知解) is a stock proclamation. Compare distinguishing, deliberation, emotional consciousness, and conjecture without treating them as automatic synonyms.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此子已後設有把茅蓋頭只成得箇知解宗徒
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄): inside a case raised in Yunfeng Wenyue's record, Huineng is the quoted patriarch who says that the novice will become only a follower of an understanding-based lineage.

Occurrences.Kwic: 神會、圭峰尚斥為知解宗徒
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wolong Zishui (夔州臥龍字水禪師語錄): in his hall address, Wolong Zishui says that even Shenhui and Guifeng Zongmi were rejected as followers of conceptual understanding and asks what hope remains for loose expounders of words.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此等見解盡屬知解宗徒
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Teaching Altar of Chan Master Shiyu (石雨禪師法檀): in the hall address for sending Yunmen Zhan's wooden image to the Jingshan patriarch hall, Shiyu Mingfang lists several attempted interpretations of an old case and says that such views all belong to followers of conceptual understanding.

Occurrences.Kwic: 入此門來，莫存知解。知解既不生，如王寶劍
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Ancestral Guidelines (列祖提綱錄): the anthology explicitly introduces Mi'an Xianjie as opening an imperial-commission hall address by warning entrants not to retain conceptual understanding.

Further Questions of Chan Master Huangbo Wunian (黃蘗無念禪師復問): replying to the student Mao Xuanshu, Huangbo Wunian Shenyou says that although Mao's letter is earnest, he has not entered the correct path and is repeatedly deceived by conceptual understanding and conjecture.

Occurrences.Kwic: 葢為這箇不是知解邊事也
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian (永覺元賢禪師廣錄). In his own small-convocation discourse, Yongjue Yuanxian marks the matter off as 'not an affair on the side of intellectual understanding' (不是知解邊事); the embedded Touzi/Cuiwei and Xuefeng cases precede his commentary.

Occurrences.Kwic: 所謂知解不消。皆為毒藥。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Essentials of Mind Transmission of Huangbo Duanji (黃檗山斷際禪師傳心法要): in his Essentials of Mind Transmission, Huangbo Xiyun says undigested intellectual understanding is all poison.
